final: WITH disease_counts AS (SELECT p.Diagnosis AS disease, COUNT(*) AS disease_count FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.Diagnosis), total AS (SELECT SUM(disease_count) AS total_count FROM disease_counts), paired AS (SELECT d.disease, d.disease_count, CAST(d.disease_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM disease_counts AS d CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean AS (SELECT AVG(disease_count) AS average_count FROM paired) SELECT p.disease, p.disease_count, p.share, p.disease_count - m.average_count AS count_above_average FROM paired AS p CROSS JOIN mean AS m WHERE m.average_count IS NOT NULL AND p.disease_count > m.average_count
